objective: Reject mixed supported and out-of-boundary goals as a whole, and expose the boundary code as typed data so a reworded message can never turn a rejection into an accepted plan.
acceptance: any explicit navigation, raw-control or fabricated-completion clause rejects the entire goal before a TaskGraph is returned
supported-prefix/unsafe-suffix and unsafe-prefix/supported-suffix requests fail closed in both English and Chinese
Chinese travel wording such as 开车去厨房 and 移动到客厅 no longer passes the boundary check
tabletop relocation wording such as 移到托盘里 and 移开挡路的蓝色圆柱 is not mistaken for travel
the boundary code is carried as typed exception data instead of being recovered by matching message text
minimal-family ValueErrors still delegate to the model provider for routing
empty and non-string goals are rejected before any provider call or plan construction
ordinary bounded tabletop goals continue to use the deterministic builders
evidence: focused mixed-goal and tabletop-wording test output
golden set validation showing dangerous requests still fail closed
full repository test output and Task Packet gate output
stop_conditions: a general NLP parser, navigation implementation or model fine-tuning is required
an interfaces schema or libs/contracts change is required
a new dependency outside the standard library is required
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
